title: OOJS 1.0 Meta-Schema
description: JSON Schema 2020-12 document that validates OOJS 1.0 schema documents (§4–§6, §11). A file that passes this schema is structurally valid as an OOJS schema; semantic constraints that require cross-field or cross-type reasoning (e.g. no inheritance cycle, discriminator-value uniqueness, required entries must name declared properties) are enforced by the schema registry loader at parse time.

title.description: Human-readable short name for the schema.

discriminator.description: Name of the discriminator property used in all instances of this schema. Defaults to '_type' when absent (§4.5).

imports.description: Map of alias → schema URI for cross-schema type references (§4.4).

types.description: Map of type name → type definition. MUST have at least one entry (§4.6).

propertyNames.description: Type name. MUST match [A-Z][A-Za-z0-9_]* and MUST NOT be a reserved primitive keyword (§11.1, §11.4).

TypeName.description: A local type name ([A-Z][A-Za-z0-9_]*) or a qualified alias-prefixed reference (alias.TypeName) (§5.2, §11.1, §11.3).

TypeDefinition.description: Definition of a named type within the schema (§5).

extends.description: Supertype reference — local name or alias-qualified name. The referenced type MUST exist in the registry (§5.2).

abstract.description: When true, this type cannot be directly instantiated (§5.3).

discriminatorValue.description: Override for the discriminator value of this type. MUST be unique across the registry (§5.4).

title.description: Human-readable short name for this type.

properties.description: Map of property name → property definition for properties declared on this type (§5.5).

required.description: Names of properties declared in this type's own 'properties' map that are required on every instance (§5.6).

PropertyDefinition.description: A property definition — primitive, array, or type reference — dispatched by the value of 'type' (§6).

PrimitiveProperty.description: Property whose value is a JSON primitive (string, integer, number, boolean, or null) (§6.1).

multipleOf.description: Value must be a multiple of this (§6.1.2).

enum.description: Allowed value set — array of strings for string type, array of numbers for integer/number (§6.1.1, §6.1.2).

ArrayProperty.description: Property whose value is a homogeneous JSON array (§6.3).

ArrayItemDefinition.description: Item type definition inside an array property — either a primitive or a type reference; nested arrays are not permitted in v1.0 (§6.3).

TypeRefProperty.description: Property whose value is an instance of a named type — enables polymorphic dispatch (§6.2).

type.description: Type name (local or alias-qualified). Must not be a primitive keyword or 'array'.
